findings.source: docs/project-brief.md (create BOTH); tasks.md 7.1; review brief deliverable 1

findings.title: 4,000,000-character cap does not bound the file under 5,000,000 bytes
findings.source: design.md §11.2 (file above INGEST_MAX_BYTES makes the fixture source unavailable); sources.py FixtureSource compares st_size in bytes
findings.detail: Multi-byte UTF-8 characters take up to 3 bytes each in the BMP, so 4,000,000 characters can exceed 5,000,000 bytes. kiro-mcp.md says the margin leaves room for multi-byte UTF-8. Low practical risk for Remotive and Arbeitnow data.
findings.action: Tell the ingestion-agent to write non-ASCII characters as \uXXXX escapes (characters then equal bytes), or lower the cap. Then correct the kiro-mcp.md claim.
